screens.prompt:
Create a mobile conversation / chat screen for "Natter" messaging app with Maya Chen. Viewport: 390x844 mobile layout.
Color Palette & Styling (Light Mode):
- Background: Very pale lavender-white page background #F1F0FF.
- Cards & received message bubbles: Crisp white #FFFFFF, shadow-sm.

- Muted light grey text / timestamps: #8A87A6.
- Primary violet accent: #5B3FD0 used for sent message bubbles (with white text), primary buttons, and the top header.

- Fonts & Typography: Geometric sans font (Montserrat / sans-serif), bold headings, medium labels, light grey previews/meta.
- Shapes: Fully rounded bubbles 18px with one tight 4px corner (sent bubbles have bottom-right tight corner 4px, received bubbles have bottom-left tight corner 4px). White rounded cards 20px. Pill chips and inputs.
- Avatars: 2-letter initials on soft pastel gradient circles (e.g. "MC" on soft coral/pink-orange gradient), NO photos, NO 3D characters.

Screen Structure:
1. Top Header:
- Solid saturated violet #5B3FD0 background with rounded bottom corners (rounded-b-2xl / rounded-b-3xl).
- Content in clean white: Back button (arrow_back icon in round ghost container), Maya Chen's initials avatar "MC" (in a 40px gradient circle with subtle white border and tiny green/orange online dot badge), title "Maya Chen" in bold white text with subtitle "online" in white/80 with small dot, and right action buttons: round translucent white call button (phone) and video button (videocam).

2. Floating Right Rail:
- A slim vertical violet (#5B3FD0) rounded pill action rail floating along the right edge of the screen (e.g. z-20, fixed/absolute right-3 top-1/3 flex flex-col gap-3 py-3 px-2 rounded-full shadow-lg shadow-primary/20) with 4 crisp white line icons: camera (photo_camera), image (image), mic (mic), location (location_on).

3. Messages Flow (scrollable container on #F1F0FF lavender background, generous airy spacing):
- Date chip pill centered: "Today" in #8A87A6 on #E9E6FF pill.
- Received bubble (White #FFFFFF, rounded-2xl rounded-bl-sm, text #1E1B3A, shadow-sm): "Hey! Did you see the new design brief?" with timestamp "10:02" in #8A87A6.
- Sent bubble (Violet #5B3FD0, rounded-2xl rounded-br-sm, text-white, shadow-md shadow-primary/10): "Yes! Working on the chat screens now" with timestamp "10:03" and double-tick icon (done_all in white/80).
- Received image bubble: White container card enclosing a gorgeous abstract pastel gradient art block (soft mesh gradient in lavender, violet, and peach with smooth rounded corners), with timestamp "10:04", and overlapping small pink reaction pill floating on bottom edge ("❤️ 2" with #FF5C8A background or white badge with pink heart and #FF5C8A text).
- Sent voice note bubble (Violet #5B3FD0, rounded-2xl rounded-br-sm, text-white): White circular play button (play_arrow), animated/clean waveform bars (vertical bars of varying heights in white/80 and white), duration "0:42", timestamp "10:05", and double-tick.
- Received bubble with reply quote: White #FFFFFF bubble. Inside at the top, a small quoted snippet with violet left accent border and pale lavender background ("Working on the chat screens now"), followed by main message: "Love it, ship it today?" with timestamp "10:06".
- Typing indicator bubble: White #FFFFFF rounded bubble with 3 animated bouncing dots in #8A87A6 / #5B3FD0.

4. Bottom Composer (Docked at bottom, clean white / lavender floating container):
- NO bottom navigation bar (chat screens do not have tab bars).
- White rounded-full pill input container with placeholder "Message...", emoji button (mood/sentiment_satisfied) on left, paperclip/attach icon, and a prominent round violet (#5B3FD0) send button with send icon in white.

Clean, airy, modern, precise execution strictly following 390x844 mobile viewport constraints and Natter design tokens.
